(Currently amended) Claim 1: A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, wherein the studs are spaced at a distance of sixteen inches on center.

(Currently amended) Claim 2: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced at a distance of twenty-four inches on center.

(Currently amended) Claim 4: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad, and at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation.

(Currently amended) Claim 5: The cooling system of claim 4, wherein the fan causes air to flow through the pad moistened by the water, thereby cooling the air by evaporation, and the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an opening.

(Currently amended) Claim 11: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes a front cover that is removable.

(Currently amended) Claim 13: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the wall is a load-bearing wall constructed using standard framing techniques.

(Currently amended) Claim 15: A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1; mounting elements; and a ventilation grill, wherein the mounting elements include a set of screws for securing the housing to the studs. 

(Currently amended) Claim 17: A cooling system, comprising: a housing configured for mounting within a structure wall, the housing containing a cooling system for evaporatively cooling an indoor area. 

(Currently amended) Claim 18: The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the housing is placed between wall studs spaced at a distance of sixteen inches on center. 

(Currently amended) Claim 19: The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the housing is placed within a structure wall, the structure wall constructed using one of structural insulated panels (SIP) and insulating concrete forms (ICF). 

(Currently amended) Claim 20: The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the housing protrudes from the wall less than three inches.
